localization_rule: After freeze, exact source paths explicitly named in the public issue body may restrict candidate generation. Otherwise use all eligible non-test C# source.
memory_order: stable sort by retained integer_delta score descending, then frozen generator order
pass_rule: Frozen baseline reproduces the issue. A zero-LLM candidate whose operator is integer_delta passes the frozen objective and relevant repository regressions. Exact winner replay must pass.
transfer_rule: A positive C# result with retained integer_delta, together with JavaScript A2 and Python A3, establishes the three-language A5 DEVELOPMENT threshold.
claim_boundary: A5 DEVELOPMENT only; a pass demonstrates one retained repair strategy across JavaScript, Python and C#.
